resolved_defect.cause: End reading was selected by date; different capture records can share a date and have different offsets/editions.
resolved_defect.fix: Position preserves captureIndices; endReading and ancillary source/manual attribution use exact capture identity.

limitations: This checks software invariants and source attribution, not a new independent visual digitization of every shoreline.
No claim of field validation, tidal correction, wave run-up correction, slope correction or calibrated absolute metre accuracy is made.
The read-only matrix covers Progreso and Dzemul for six edition states across 2010..2026; source/date integrity for other editions depends on the separate full municipal source audits.
Hunucma transect directions were checked numerically; its disputed 394 interpretation was not reviewed here.
